transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Well, I'm here because I keep hearing voices at work. I'm a nursing assistant, and... they come right out of the call-light speaker, and sometimes the hallway vents. They keep telling me exactly which patient records have been changed. 

It's just as clear as somebody standing right next to me, even when the unit is completely quiet and nobody else hears it.
How long have you been hearing these voices?
It's been going on for about two months now. It started right around the time I was asked to help lead the new wound-care documentation rollout at the facility.
Over these past two months, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?
No, I haven't felt down or depressed at all. I mean, I haven't really had any feelings of hopelessness over these last couple of months. It's just... well, mostly just those voices I mentioned.
Have you been using any alcohol or recreational drugs?
No, I don't drink alcohol or use any recreational drugs. I haven't used anything like that at all.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or neurological conditions?
No, I haven't. Um, my health is actually pretty good. I don't have any medical conditions or... neurological issues or anything like that.
